payload.claim: The comment calls the carried pull request under CHANGES_REQUESTED, APPROVED and REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED 'the exhausted mode's open draft', but a CHANGES_REQUESTED or APPROVED row's pull request is an ordinary READY_FOR_REVIEW draft that `reconcile` later moved after a human review — it never passed through package()'s exhausted mode. Only the EXHAUSTED case (and arguably REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED) is actually tied to that mode. A reader trusting this comment could later narrow the guard to 'exhausted-mode rows only', reopening the data-loss bug this guard exists to close for CHANGES_REQUESTED/APPROVED rows, which is exactly the kind of mismatch the gates cannot see.
